canDo: Can actively draw on the grammar learnt in unfamiliar but everyday tasks, not just recognise correct answers.
review: No new systematic grammar; review according to your error map.
input: 3 sets each of listening and reading, mixing time, services and opinions.
output: Write a 140-word combined task; speak for 3 minutes: yourself + an experience + a plan.
checkpoint: As a guide for moving on to the transfer phase: ≥85% recognition, ≥80% controlled production, ≥75% free sentences.
challenge: Today’s challenge: give yourself a 15-minute mini-test: record 3 minutes of speaking (who I am + an experience + a plan), then write a 5-sentence written summary; going through the grammar points of the first 17 days, circle 3 structures you used actively and 3 you haven’t used yet.

questions.why: Half versus a third is the share in work/training; 61% is the share who got their licence, a different indicator.
People living more than twenty kilometres from a driving school give up most often — « ce qui est précisément le problème que l'aide devait résoudre ».
« Ce que nous contestons, c'est la méthode »: proposed on 12 May, voted on the 24th, with no meeting for families.
« Si le calendrier devait être maintenu, nous souhaiterions au minimum qu'une réunion publique se tienne avant le vote » — a fallback request.
46% say they buy newspapers and magazines, but these make up less than 9% of turnover.
« L'explication tenterait de passer par la mauvaise foi ; elle est plus simple » — the reason is that decisions and memory work differently.
The gain from zero to fifteen minutes is greater than from thirty to forty-five.
The ending explicitly excludes strength training and says the official recommendation still stands.
He says attracting young doctors is a ten-year job; « Dans l'immédiat, ce qui m'aiderait le plus, c'est un assistant médical ».
Five minutes saved per patient × forty patients ≈ three hours; it isn’t about longer consultations.
She says clearly that she gets the gist; the problem is that she’s too slow putting sentences together. Reading was never a problem.
« le bail n'est pas renouvelable », so they must move out by 1 March; the address hasn’t been decided.
Fifteen and forty minutes are very different, « c'est précisément pour ça que je ne veux pas annoncer une adresse avant d'être sûr ».
« il n'y aura pas de réduction d'effectif liée à ce déménagement », and it is in the document sent out that evening.
« C'est un motif d'entrée »; ten minutes later the talk is often about conflicts, exams or family.
Part-time: two days a week there is nobody there.
« un local où l'on ne s'entende pas depuis le couloir » — afraid of being overheard, pupils don’t talk.
